summary: Iteration 14: all requested features PASS. Backend 8/8 (saved shipping addresses: newest-first, dedupe incl. whitespace-stripped, max 10, invalid ship not saved, auth required; admin GET /orders/{id} + reply confirm). Frontend: order cards at 360/375px (Alla ordrar, Mina ordrar, home) show order number on a single line (height == font-size 24px), badge on same row, never truncated, date/company on next row. Home favourites + recent orders collapsed by default, expand/collapse works. Admin 'new' notification tap -> /order/<id>; order-reply-open-button opens reply-sheet; empty message validation shown; confirm succeeded (Resend NOT rate-limited this run) -> timeline Bekräftad, order-ready-button appears, button label 'Skicka nytt svar'. Alla ordrar order-reply-button-<num> still opens the same sheet; close works. Checkout: saved-address-toggle only after choosing delivery-ship, saved-address-0/1 fill name/address/postal/city correctly (incl. clearing name) and close the list. No deprecated Expo packages in touched files.

minor.issue: Saved-address update is read-modify-write from the request's user doc; two concurrent ship orders by same user can lose one address (low impact).

issues: After 'Beställ igen' the success toast ('1 st lagda i varukorgen') lingers and overlaps the address form fields on the checkout screen (cosmetic, transient).
No way to remove an outdated saved address (nice-to-have).

action_items: Optional: use an atomic Mongo update (pipeline $set with $filter/$slice) for user.addresses to avoid lost updates under concurrency.
Optional: offer delete for saved addresses; consider dismissing reorder toast on navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/orders.py create_order: addresses saved after insert but before email send – fine; dedupe compares all 4 fields after strip – OK.
React Query cache is cleared on logout (auth.tsx) so ['addresses'] does not leak across users – OK.
Web preview note: Modal slide animation means clicks immediately after opening reply-sheet may land off-viewport in Playwright; wait ~1s (test artifact, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Used seed_iter13_ui.py + seed_iter14_ui.py (saved addresses + admin 'new' notification for UI13NEW); all cleaned up. Pytest creates a delivered+t14<tag>@resend.dev customer and 3 real orders (3 order emails + 1 reply email), removed in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run test_iter14 with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist; module fixture shared across classes). UI seed: python tests/seed_iter13_ui.py && python tests/seed_iter14_ui.py; cleanup with seed_iter13_ui.py cleanup. Order emails count against Resend rate limit.
